THISZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT(this "Agreement"). made as of the 24 day ofApril  2026, by and between UHAB Housing Development Fund Corporation, having an address at 120 Wall Street, 2oth Floor, New York, NY 10005 (*"Owner"), and Crystal House at East Harlem LLC, having an address at 5180 Roswell Road, #203, Atlanta GA 30342 (Developer")(Owner and Developer are sometimes hereinafter collectively referred to as the“Parties"). WITNESS ETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, County of New York, City and State of New York, being Lot 21 in Block 1667 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Owner Land": the buildings and improvements located thereon or which may be located thereon in the future are herein referred to as the “Owner Building": and the Owner Land and the Owner Building are herein collectively referred to as the“OwnerParcel"): WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, County of New York, City and State of New York, being Lot 120 in Block 1667 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, as more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto and made a part hereof (the “Developer Land" said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the “Developer Building.” and the Developer Land and the Developer Building being herein collectively called the “Developer Parcel"): WHEREAS, Developer intends to construct one or more new buildings on all or a portion of the Developer Land (each, a “New Developer Building"), with a bulk that would be in excess of the bulk permitted to be constructed on Developer Land under the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined), if the Developer Land was considered as a separate and independent zoning lot; WHEREAS, there are certain “Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) appurtenant to the Owner Land that are in excess of the “Retained Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) and that are available for transfer in accordance with the Zoning Resolution; WHEREAS, Owner and Developer intend to make the “Excess Development Rights" (as hereinafter defined) available for utilization in connection with the construction of the New Developer Building; WHEREAS,the Parties heretoare simultaneouslyherewith executing a Declaration ofZoning Lot Restrictions (the “Declaration") in accordance with certain provisions set forth in a definition of the term “zoning lot" in Section 12-10 of the Zoning Resolution (as hereinafter defined) in order to create a single zoning lot comprised of the Owner Parcel and the 2
